caption: John explicitly quotes Psalm 22 when soldiers divide Jesus’s clothes and cast lots. The literary fulfilment is certain; advance prediction is not independently proved.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 22 predict the divided clothes? The psalm says enemies divide the sufferer’s garments and cast lots. John describes soldiers doing both to Jesus.
slides.body: The psalm says enemies divide the sufferer’s garments and cast lots. John describes soldiers doing both to Jesus.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 22 predict the divided clothes?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 22:18: They divide my garments … and cast lots for my clothing.
slides.body: They divide my garments … and cast lots for my clothing.
slides.heading: Ps 22:18

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Jn 19:23–24, BSB: They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing. So that is what the soldiers did.
slides.body: They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing. So that is what the soldiers did.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Jn 19:23–24

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: John makes the link explicit He quotes Psalm 22 almost word for word and says the soldiers’ action fulfilled Scripture.
slides.body: He quotes Psalm 22 almost word for word and says the soldiers’ action fulfilled Scripture.
slides.heading: John makes the link explicit

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The connection is certain What remains unproved is advance prediction. John knew the psalm and deliberately used it to explain Jesus’s death.
slides.body: What remains unproved is advance prediction. John knew the psalm and deliberately used it to explain Jesus’s death.
slides.heading: The connection is certain

title: They divided his clothes
